title: GCL NoteWriteRecord
description: One append-only record per mediated note mutation, stored as a line in .gcl/note-writes.jsonl. Authoritative for note mutation history (see spec/Note-Provenance.md). This schema is the field-name/type authority the spec prose defers to.

schema_version.description: Present on newly emitted v1 records; absence is read as a legacy-v1 record (deployed history predates the discriminator).

path.description: Normalized workspace-relative note path; never absolute/drive/UNC, and never containing a NUL or a '.'/'..' traversal segment. The writer normalizes and containment-checks before recording.

operation.description: Which note primitive ran. An unknown value MUST be surfaced as uninterpreted, never coerced.

written_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the mutation. Distinct from the frontmatter provenance axis 'stamped_at' (when the snapshot was stamped).

content_sha256.description: sha256 (hex) of the mutation payload: complete written content for 'write'; appended chunk for 'append'.

principal.description: Accountable human the session acts for (session-derived).

mediation_standing.description: Honest standing of mediated_by (e.g. 'declared'), never 'verified' for a hosted connector.

model.description: Declared model/mind — provenance only, never a key.

family.description: Declared model family/grouping — display only, never a key.

instance.description: Per-seat substrate-isolation handle — audit only, never a coordination id.
